name: Hospital da Luz (Luz Saude)
verdict: Operated by Luz Saude: 60% Fidelidade (itself 84.99% Fosun, 15% state-owned CGD), 40% a Macquarie infrastructure fund. The Portuguese state stake is a passive minority. Nothing found.
note: Rated during the Arouca research (issue #386). Chain: Hospital da Luz -> Luz Saude -> Fidelidade (60%, after Macquarie European Infrastructure Fund 7 bought 40% in Sep 2025) -> Fosun Group 84.9892% / CGD 15%. CGD is a bank owned by the Portuguese State, but its Fidelidade stake is a passive minority holding (about 9% effective in Luz Saude) with no control - state ownership alone is not a tier (METHOD.md).
